title: Fraction of a fraction applications
description: Use the rule in everyday and mathematical situations.

questions.prompt: A recipe uses 3/4 of a cup of oats. You make 2/3 of the recipe. How many cups of oats do you need? Type a simplified fraction.
A garden is 5/6 planted with vegetables. 1/4 of the vegetables are carrots. What fraction of the whole garden is carrots?
Find 4/9 of 3/8. Type a simplified fraction.
